claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: PSB-1115 is a selective A2B adenosine receptor antagonist that, like other adenosine receptor ligands, only inhibits proliferation at micromolar concentrations via receptor-independent mechanisms, so at 2.5 uM it is expected to produce little or no cytotoxicity.
